title: soil3 Episode V1
x-lifecycle-notes: One episode records one complete care experience: create opens it from a real state.v1 snapshot, update attaches caller-supplied facts while it is open, read returns it unchanged, and close finalizes it exactly once. Lifecycle is open -> closed; a closed record is immutable. strategy, gate_result, and outcome are set-once; executed_actions and feedback are append-only fact lists. At close, every tracked section nobody supplied is listed in missing_facts instead of being fabricated. The store computes state_binding.state_sha256 from the embedded snapshot using the same canonical encoding strategy.v1 binds with, so a strategy carrying a different state_sha256 is refused. The model's hidden thought process is never recorded: payloads carrying reasoning-shaped keys (chain_of_thought, hidden_reasoning, raw_reasoning, reasoning_trace, thinking) are refused, and only structured outputs such as reason_summary, confidence, and decision are stored. gate.v1 and feedback.v1 are planned protocols, so their sections are stored as the caller's structured payloads; a gate decision, when present, must use the allow / allow_with_warning / deny vocabulary. Cross-record binding checks and set-once/append semantics cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are enforced by services/soil3/episode/episode_v1.py.

closed_at.description: Set exactly once, when the episode closes; null while open.

state_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the embedded state.v1 snapshot under the same key-order-independent JSON encoding strategy.v1 uses, computed by the store; never caller-authored.

state_observed_at.description: The snapshot's observed_at normalized to the canonical notation when parseable; null when the source carried no usable time. Never invented.

state_generated_at.description: Traceability metadata, not a binding condition of its own, exactly as in strategy.v1.

initial_state.description: The frozen state.v1 snapshot the episode was opened from, embedded verbatim and read-only. Its full contract lives with the state.v1 producer, not here.

strategy.description: Caller-supplied strategy.v1 record (set-once). reason_summary and confidence are preserved exactly; a state_sha256 or state_observed_at that does not match the embedded snapshot is refused.

gate_result.description: Caller-supplied gate result (set-once). gate.v1 is planned, so only the envelope is constrained here: decision, when present, is one of allow / allow_with_warning / deny, and reason_codes, when present, is a list of non-empty strings.

executed_actions.description: Append-only facts about what actually executed, as reported by the caller. executed_at, when present and parseable, is normalized to the canonical notation. The store never adds, edits, or removes entries.

feedback.description: Append-only factual post-action observations as reported by the caller. feedback.v1 is planned, so entries are stored as supplied; observed_at, when present and parseable, is normalized. Visual-feedback collection timing belongs to Issue #30, not to this record.

outcome.description: Caller-supplied factual outcome evaluation (set-once; may be supplied at close). Independent evaluations are preserved as supplied; episode.v1 computes no unified reward.

missing_facts.description: Finalized at close: the tracked sections nobody supplied. An empty fact list counts as absent. Absence is stated, never filled in.

rfc3339_utc.description: The one timestamp notation episode.v1 writes: RFC 3339 in UTC with a Z suffix, the same form strategy.v1 carries and state.v1 writes for generated_at.
